text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod /v1/stream gateway spike: 5xx rate 6.8% over 5m (baseline 0.3%). paging on-call: @Sara L., @Mike K. autoscale: none triggered.

Sara L.: seeing it, joining. any customer-facing errors reported?

Mike K.: oncall sig. I see a surge in 502/504s and a subset of `client canceled` disconnects. Possibly chunked downstream closes.

Anita: tagging metrics - streaming request lat p95 jumped from 220ms -> 1.2s, errors concentrated in eu-west-1.

Ops_Ric: adding quick note: heavy fanout routes to dedicated-gateway pool. I opened a dashboard: /dashboards/streaming-gateway-errors (link).

Dan: logs show repeated: `upstream read error: connection reset by peer` and `chunked encoding: unexpected EOF`. sample:```
2025-11-03T09:12:08Z gateway-1 request_id=abc123 upstream=10.2.5.7:8080 status=502 msg="upstream read error: connection reset by peer"
2025-11-03T09:12:09Z gateway-1 request_id=abc124 status=200 chunked=partial client_closed=1
```

Emily: any recent deploys to gateway or model routing?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: ref=feature/chunked-retry-fix commit=9f2a0b4 by anita @ 09:05 UTC (4 minutes before alerts).

Sara L.: ok likely correlated. rollback candidate? Can we do a quick revert to last known good?

Mike K.: I can roll back gateway config. Plan: 1) pin routing to fallback model `rw-small-v1` for streaming routes 2) scale dedicated-gateway pool +20% 3) disable chunked-retry feature. Need approval.

Anita: +1 for rollback, we saw intermittent timeouts during canary. I pushed the feature too fast.

Ops_Ric: scaling now: `k scale deploy gateway-dedicated --replicas=12` (was 10). watching.

Dan: I'm attaching a quick reproduction curl for debugging:```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream"
  https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"debug"}'
# watch for `event: error` or premature connection close
```

Emily: customer impact check: top 3 customers with errors are a streaming-analytics startup (10% of their calls failing), internal smoke tests show partial failures but no data loss. SLA impact: elevated error rate could trigger P0 if sustained >10m.

Sara L.: tagging support to prepare notice if we hit 10% for 10m. @Dan, keep logs coming.

Dan: adding proxy trace snippet:```
[trace] 09:12:10 GET /v1/stream req=abc125 route=fanout-16 proxy_to=upstream-7 code=502 time=362ms reason="upstream reset while sending chunk"
```

Mike K.: I've started rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/gateway-dedicated gateway=image@sha256:prev` (kickoff 09:13). deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: rollback started: target ref=main@sha256:7a3c1d - rolling update to 12 pods.

Anita: while rollback runs, let's enable graceful-retry path in the gateway to convert some 502s to 503 with retry-after headers so clients can back off. small config change: `enable_graceful_retry: true`.

Ops_Ric: applied `enable_graceful_retry: true` to eu-west-1 via configmap patch.

Dan: tailing logs: error rate trending down to 3.2% now. chunked disconnects still present but less frequent.

Emily: ETA for rollback completion? Any chance the model routing pin causes degraded quality?

Mike K.: rollout almost done, awaiting final pod readiness. Routing pin to `rw-small-v1` will yield slightly smaller outputs but acceptable for mitigation.

Sara L.: good. set incident severity to Sev2 for now. Customer comms hold unless >10% 10m.

Dan: request tracing shows a class of clients that open long-lived connections and then issue client-side cancel after ~45s which leaves upstream in partial-chunk state. We should track client cancellation metrics separately.

Anita: follow-up action: add explicit `Connection: close` guidance for these long-poll clients in docs. Also add server-side idle timeout to upstream to avoid half-open chunked sessions.

Mike K.: rollback complete at 09:18. Post-rollback checks: p50 210ms, p95 260ms, 5xx 0.9% (within normal).

Ops_Ric: running a 30m watch. Alert suppression in monitoring for the failed rule for next 20m to avoid noisy alerts.

Emily: customer-impact summary for the incident window 09:12-09:18: ~6 minutes elevated errors, max 6.8% error rate, ~3% of streaming sessions saw disconnects; top customer incidents notified internally. No SLA breach. Recommend postmortem focused on deploy gating and chunked-session timeouts.

Sara L.: assigning follow-ups:
- Anita: revert feature branch PR and add automated canary tests for chunked flows.
- Dan: implement client-cancel metric and add upstream idle timeout (48h ticket).
- Ops_Ric: update runbook with graceful_retry toggle and scaling thresholds.
- Mike K.: coordinate rollback postmortem and deploy gating.

Anita: ack. I'll open the PR revert and link to this thread.

Mike K.: handing off to @Mike K. for overnight watch. @Emily will prepare a short incident note for postmortem.

Sara L.: thanks team. closing thread when ops watch complete and follow-ups filed. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated elapsed=14m actions=[rollback,scale-up,graceful-retry]. incident_id=INC-2050004321.
